outreach_text:
Hello Maddisons Bakery team,

I'm Amala from MultiMax. We build affordable websites for local businesses. I came across your family-run bakery on Long Lane in Bexleyheath and prepared an independent website concept showing your bread, cakes and sandwiches, along with clear contact details and directions.

I found your Facebook presence through public business listings, but did not find a standalone official website during my checks. This is an unsolicited design concept, not your official website or an endorsement. The bread illustration is illustrative, not a photograph of your products.

Live preview:
https://amalraj020-a11y.github.io/10am-office-work/websites/maddisons-bakery-bexleyheath/

Source code:
https://github.com/amalraj020-a11y/10am-office-work/tree/main/websites/maddisons-bakery-bexleyheath

I've attached two current screenshots, showing the desktop and mobile versions. You can also view them here:
https://amalraj020-a11y.github.io/10am-office-work/work/screenshots/maddisons-bakery-bexleyheath-desktop.png
https://amalraj020-a11y.github.io/10am-office-work/work/screenshots/maddisons-bakery-bexleyheath-mobile.png

If this direction appeals to you, reply and we can discuss the changes you would like and a small agreed budget before any paid work begins. This preview does not take orders or payments; backend or database features would be optional later work, agreed separately.

If this isn't of interest, just let me know and I won't follow up.

Kind regards,
Amala
MultiMax
